summary: Elevate 21 sustainable EKODI ecosystem attributes to the supreme mandatory constitutional layer and bind architecture, development, AI, data, security, UX, integrations, operations, cost governance and all future generations to non-regression enforcement.
approvalBasis: The EKODI Platform Super Administrator explicitly instructed EKODI to set and strongly apply these attributes as the highest and absolute properties of the EKODI ecosystem constitution and to build the enforcement needed for reliable operation.
evidence: CONSTITUTION.md Section 0 Supreme Ecosystem Attributes Constitution
scripts/validate-constitution.mjs supreme-attribute integrity and validator bindings
AGENTS.override.md mandatory agent assessment and non-waiver instructions
existing EKODI Constitution Check CI executes validate-constitution.mjs on governance changes
generationImpact: Generation 10 remains the active baseline; the supreme attributes bind Generation 10 and every evidence-defined future generation.
scaleImpact: No automatic scale promotion. Existing S0-S3 evidence gates remain unchanged.
authorityImpact: No autonomous authority expansion. AI, providers, services and workspaces cannot waive the supreme attributes; final constitutional authority remains the EKODI Platform Super Administrator.
rollback: If enforcement code produces a false block, technically revert the defective validator commit to the last known-good guard while retaining the approved supreme-attribute policy intent, repair the validator in isolation, revalidate and re-promote through the guarded pipeline.
